features.name: USB screen, controls & audio recorder

footprint.scope: Linked source module only; selected firmware memory and delivery are unqualified.

features.name: Stem splitting

features.name: Autotune
features.description: Correct or shift the pitch of a monophonic input.
features.evidence: T2P is packaged with 22 CPU groups and two stock PCM checks. It has no physical listening result and does not include the full Input FX, key/scale interface or formant processor.
features.blocker: The listening candidate and a shared Synth/Autotune entry must be qualified before selectable installation.

footprint.scope: T2P prototype including inherited P6S owners; not an additive composition budget.
